long_biography.plain_text:
Fitzroy Engineering's managing director, Peter White-Robinson, received an employee's proposal to restore Pukekura Park's waterwheel. Gordon Wilson approached him after noticing that the wheel had stopped turning. The company joined other local businesses and the council in the repair, strengthening the structure and ensuring it could turn freely. The wheel had once powered the Okato dairy factory before becoming a park attraction.

White-Robinson also maintained links with Whangārei Boys' High School, which he attended in the 1960s. His continuing interest in Carruth House and a substantial donation earned recognition from the school's old boys' association.
